comment: Ultimate's dash (a02dash): the glide's push-off (owner p6p: lower, the feet trailing, the head level), on the Dash row's 28 frames; its frames 4-11 eased into her run's own frames so the game's cut to the run (dash_to_run 12) lands on the run's first, and a dash played on past it (no run) eased back by 20 (owner 2026-10-20: "the end of the start run animation should be pretty much the exact same as the 1st frame of the running animation").
